page.overview:
Who is Mansion's Guards?

The Mansion's Guards are employees of the , hired by Klahadore to act as security guards to keep Kaya's mansion safe.

The guards are composed of two men, wearing black suits, ties, white shirts, and sunglasses.

The one on the left, in a green tie, is a skinny man with a mustache and beard. He has brown hair that is spiked up at the top.

The guard on the right, in a red tie, is larger than his partner, and is clean-shaven. He has slicked back black hair, that is long in the back.
